age_sex_balance.note: descriptive balance check, exploratory; not a confirmatory test

sex.note: GEO gives no sex field; do not guess. Sex can only be inferred from expression (XIST / Y-linked genes) in T-002, and would then be labelled inferred.

data_processing: Basecalling was done by Illumina analysis pipeline CASAVA (version 1.8.2).
Genes with less than 10 fragments in all the samples were removed, and then the normalized fragment count for each gene was calculated by R/Bioconductor package DESeq (version 1.10.1).
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: The first column is gene symbol. The other columns are normalized expression values (estimated by DESeq) for all the samples.
The number of fragments in each known gene from RefSeq database (downloaded from UCSC Genome Browser on March 6, 2013) was enumerated using htseq-count from HTSeq package (version 0.5.3p9).
The reads were mapped to human genome (hg19) by TopHat (version 2.0.7) and Bowtie2 (version 2.1.0).

samples.growth_protocol: Primary fibroblast cultures were maintained in DMEM high glucose (Life Technologies) containing 15% fetal bovine serum (Hyclone) and 1% non-essential amino acids (Life Technologies).  Cells were passaged by incubating in 0.25% trypsin-EDTA (Life Technologies) for 5 min, and harvested for RNA isolation when they reached ~80-85% confluence.
